source.title: The Diatessaron (Section 1)
source.breadcrumbs: Home > Fathers of the Church > The Diatessaron (Tatian) > Section 1

paragraphs.text: 1 {{BIBLE:joh 1:1}} In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and God is the [2,3] Word. {{BIBLE:joh 1:2}} This was in the beginning with God. {{BIBLE:joh 1:3}} Everything was by his hand, and 4 without him not even one existing thing was made. {{BIBLE:joh 1:4}} In him was life, and the life 5 is the light of men. {{BIBLE:joh 1:5}} And the light shines in the darkness, and the darkness apprehended it not.

6 {{BIBLE:luk 1:5}} There was in the days of Herod the king a priest whose name was Zacharias, of the family of Abijah; and his wife was of the daughters of Aaron, and her name 7 was Elizabeth. {{BIBLE:luk 1:6}} And they were both righteous before God, walking in all his commands, 8 and in the uprightness of God without reproach. {{BIBLE:luk 1:7}} And they had no son, for 9 Elizabeth was barren, and they had both advanced in age. {{BIBLE:luk 1:8}} And while he discharged 10 [Arabic, p. 2] the duties of priest in the order of his service before God, {{BIBLE:luk 1:9}} according to the custom of the priesthood it was his turn to burn incense; so he entered the 11 temple of the Lord. {{BIBLE:luk 1:10}} And the whole gathering of the people were praying without at the 12 time of the incense. {{BIBLE:luk 1:11}} And there appeared unto Zacharias the angel of the Lord, standing 13 at the right of the altar of incense; {{BIBLE:luk 1:12}} and Zacharias was troubled when he saw him, 14 and fear fell upon him. {{BIBLE:luk 1:13}} But the angel said unto him, Be not agitated, Zacharias, for your prayer is heard, and your wife Elizabeth shall bear you a son, and you shall 15 call his name John; {{BIBLE:luk 1:14}} and you shall have joy and gladness, and many shall rejoice 16 at his birth. {{BIBLE:luk 1:15}} And he shall be great before the Lord, and shall not drink wine nor strong drink, and he shall be filled with the Holy Spirit while he is in his mother's 17 womb. {{BIBLE:luk 1:16}} And he shall turn back many of the children of Israel to the Lord their 18 God. {{BIBLE:luk 1:17}} And he shall go before him in the spirit, and in the power of Elijah the prophet, to turn back the heart of the fathers to the sons, and those that obey not to the knowledge of the righteous; and to prepare for the Lord a perfect people. 19 {{BIBLE:luk 1:18}} And Zacharias said unto the angel, How shall I know this, since I am an old man 20 and my wife is advanced in years? {{BIBLE:luk 1:19}} And the angel answered and said unto him, I am Gabriel, that stands before God; and I was sent to speak unto you, and give 21 you tidings of this. {{BIBLE:luk 1:20}} Henceforth you shall be speechless, and shall not be able to speak until the day in which this shall come to pass, because you did not trust 22 this my word, which shall be accomplished in its time. {{BIBLE:luk 1:21}} And the people were standing [Arabic, p. 3] awaiting Zacharias, and they were perplexed at his delaying in the temple. 23 {{BIBLE:luk 1:22}} And when Zacharias went out, he was not able to speak unto them: so they knew that he had seen in the temple a vision; and he made signs unto them, and 24 continued dumb. {{BIBLE:luk 1:23}} And when the days of his service were completed, he departed to his dwelling.

25 {{BIBLE:luk 1:24}} And after those days Elizabeth his wife conceived; and she hid herself five 26 months, and said, {{BIBLE:luk 1:25}} This has the Lord done unto me in the days when he looked upon me, to remove my reproach from among men.

27 {{BIBLE:luk 1:26}} And in the sixth month Gabriel the angel was sent from God to Galilee to a 28 city called Nazareth, {{BIBLE:luk 1:27}} to a virgin given in marriage to a man named Joseph, of the 29 house of David; and the virgin's name was Mary. {{BIBLE:luk 1:28}} And the angel entered unto her and said unto her, Peace be unto you, you who are filled with grace. Our Lord 30 is with you, you blessed among women. {{BIBLE:luk 1:29}} And she, when she beheld, was agitated 31 at his word, and pondered what this salutation could be. {{BIBLE:luk 1:30}} And the angel said unto 32 her, Fear not, Mary, for you have found favour with God. {{BIBLE:luk 1:31}} You shall now conceive, 33 and bear a son, and call his name Jesus. {{BIBLE:luk 1:32}} This shall be great, and shall be called the Son of the Most High; and the Lord God will give him the throne of 34 David his father: and he shall rule over the house of Jacob for ever; {{BIBLE:luk 1:33}} and to his 35 kingdom there shall be no end. {{BIBLE:luk 1:34}} Mary said unto the angel, How shall this be to 36 me when no man has known me? {{BIBLE:luk 1:35}} The angel answered and said unto her, The [Arabic, p. 4] Holy Spirit will come, and the power of the Most High shall rest upon you, and therefore shall he that is born of you be pure, and shall be called the Son 37 of God. {{BIBLE:luk 1:36}} And lo, Elizabeth your kinswoman, she also has conceived a son in her old 38 age; and this is the sixth month with her, her that is called barren. {{BIBLE:luk 1:37}} For nothing is 39 difficult for God. {{BIBLE:luk 1:38}} Mary said, Lo, I am the handmaid of the Lord; let it be unto me according unto your word. And the angel departed from her.

40 {{BIBLE:luk 1:39}} And then Mary arose in those days and went in haste into the hill country, to a 41 city of Judah; {{BIBLE:luk 1:40}} and entered into the house of Zacharias, and asked for the health of 42 Elizabeth. {{BIBLE:luk 1:41}} And when Elizabeth heard the salutation of Mary, the babe leaped in 43 her womb. {{BIBLE:luk 1:42}} And Elizabeth was filled with the Holy Spirit; and cried with a loud voice and said unto Mary, Blessed are you among women, and blessed is the 44 fruit that is in your womb. {{BIBLE:luk 1:43}} Whence have I this privilege, that the mother of my 45 Lord should come unto me? {{BIBLE:luk 1:44}} When the sound of your salutation reached my ears, 46 with great joy rejoiced the babe in my womb. {{BIBLE:luk 1:45}} And blessed is she who believed 47 that what was spoken to her from the Lord would be fulfilled. {{BIBLE:luk 1:46}} And Mary said,

My soul does magnify the Lord,
48 {{BIBLE:luk 1:47}} And my spirit has rejoiced in God my Saviour,
49 {{BIBLE:luk 1:48}} Who has looked upon the low estate of his handmaiden:
Lo, henceforth, all generations shall pronounce blessing on me.
50 {{BIBLE:luk 1:49}} For he has done great things for me, who is mighty,
And holy is his name.
51 {{BIBLE:luk 1:50}} And his mercy embraces them who fear him,
Throughout the ages and the times.
52 [Arabic, p. 5] {{BIBLE:luk 1:51}} He wrought the victory with his arm,
And scattered them that prided themselves in their opinions.
53 {{BIBLE:luk 1:52}} He overthrew them that acted haughtily from their thrones,
And raised the lowly.
54 {{BIBLE:luk 1:53}} He satisfied with good things the hungry,
And left the rich without anything.
55 {{BIBLE:luk 1:54}} He helped Israel his servant,
And remembered his mercy
56 {{BIBLE:luk 1:55}} (According as he spoke with our fathers)
Unto Abraham and unto his seed for ever.
57 {{BIBLE:luk 1:56}} And Mary abode with Elizabeth about three months, and returned unto her house.

58, 59 {{BIBLE:luk 1:57}} And Elizabeth's time of delivery had come; and she brought forth a son. {{BIBLE:luk 1:58}} And her neighbours and kinsfolk heard that God had multiplied his mercy towards her; 60 and they rejoiced with her. {{BIBLE:luk 1:59}} And when it was the eighth day, they came to circumcise the child, and called him Zacharias, calling him by the name of his father. 61 {{BIBLE:luk 1:60}} And his mother answered and said unto them, Not so; but he shall be called John. 62 {{BIBLE:luk 1:61}} And they said unto her, There is no man of your kindred that is called by this name. 63, 64 {{BIBLE:luk 1:62}} And they made signs to his father, saying, How do you wish to name him? {{BIBLE:luk 1:63}} And he asked for a tablet, and wrote and said, His name is John. And every one wondered. 65 {{BIBLE:luk 1:64}} And immediately his mouth was opened, and his tongue, and he spoke and 66 praised God. {{BIBLE:luk 1:65}} And fear fell on all their neighbours: and this was spoken of in all 67 the mountains of Judah. {{BIBLE:luk 1:66}} And all who heard pondered in their hearts and said, What shall this child be? And the hand of the Lord was with him.
68 {{BIBLE:luk 1:67}} And Zacharias his father was filled with the Holy Spirit, and prophesied and said,

69 {{BIBLE:luk 1:68}} Blessed is the Lord, the God of Israel,
Who has cared for his people, and wrought for it salvation;
70 {{BIBLE:luk 1:69}} And has raised for us the horn of salvation
[Arabic, p. 6] In the house of David his servant
71 {{BIBLE:luk 1:70}} (As he spoke by the mouth of his holy prophets from eternity),
72 {{BIBLE:luk 1:71}} That he might save us from our enemies,
And from the hand of all them that hate us.
73 {{BIBLE:luk 1:72}} And he has performed his mercy towards our fathers,
And remembered his holy covenants,
74 {{BIBLE:luk 1:73}} And the oath which he swore unto Abraham our father,
75 {{BIBLE:luk 1:74}} That he would give us deliverance from the hand of our enemies,
And without fear we shall serve before him
76 {{BIBLE:luk 1:75}} All our days with equity and righteousness.
77 {{BIBLE:luk 1:76}} And as for you, O child, prophet of the Most High shall you be called.
You shall go forth before the face of the Lord to prepare his way,
78 {{BIBLE:luk 1:77}} To give the knowledge of salvation unto his people,
For the forgiveness of their sins,
79 {{BIBLE:luk 1:78}} Through the mercy of the compassion of our God,
With which he cares for us, to appear from on high
80 {{BIBLE:luk 1:79}} To give light to them that sit in darkness and under the shadow of death,
And to set straight our feet in the way of peace.
81 And the child grew and became strong in the spirit, and abode in the desert until the time of his appearing unto the children of Israel.

source.source_note: Source. Translated by Hope W. Hogg. From Ante-Nicene Fathers, Vol. 9. Edited by Allan Menzies. (Buffalo, NY: Christian Literature Publishing Co., 1896.) Revised and edited for New Advent by Kevin Knight. <http://www.newadvent.org/fathers/100201.htm>.

latex.p0002: 1 \BibleRef{若 1:1} 在起初已有圣言，圣言与天主同在，圣言就是天主 [2,3]。\BibleRef{若 1:2} 这道\Emph{原是}在起初与天主同在。\BibleRef{若 1:3} 万物是藉他的手造成的，4 凡受造的，没有一样不是藉着他\Emph{而造的}。\BibleRef{若 1:4} 在他内有生命，这生命 5 是人的光。\BibleRef{若 1:5} 光照在黑暗中，黑暗不能征服它。
latex.p0003: 6 \BibleRef{路 1:5} 在黑落德王的日子，有一位司祭，名叫匝加利亚，属于阿彼雅班次；他的妻子是亚郎的女儿，名叫依撒伯尔。\BibleRef{路 1:6} 两人在天主前都是义人，遵行主的一切诫命，在天主面前无可指摘。\BibleRef{路 1:7} 他们没有孩子，因为依撒伯尔不能生育，两人又都上了年纪。\BibleRef{路 1:8} 匝加利亚按班次在天主前尽司祭的职务时，\BibleRef{路 1:9} 照司祭的常例，抽中了签，得进主的圣殿烧香。\BibleRef{路 1:10} 烧香的时候，众百姓在外面祈祷。\BibleRef{路 1:11} 有上主的天使显现给匝加利亚，站在香坛右边。\BibleRef{路 1:12} 匝加利亚看见，惊惶失措，害怕起来。\BibleRef{路 1:13} 但天使对他说：\Quote{匝加利亚，不要害怕！因为你的祈祷已蒙应允，你的妻子依撒伯尔要给你生一个儿子，你要给他起名叫若翰。\BibleRef{路 1:14} 你必欢喜快乐，许多人也要因他的诞生而喜乐。\BibleRef{路 1:15} 他在主面前将是伟大的，淡酒浓酒都不喝，而且他还在母胎中就要充满圣神。\BibleRef{路 1:16} 他要使许多以色列子民归向上主、他们的天主。\BibleRef{路 1:17} 他要以厄里亚的精神和能力，走在主前面，使父亲的心转向儿子，使悖逆者转向义人的明智，为主准备一个完善的百姓。} \BibleRef{路 1:18} 匝加利亚对天使说：\Quote{我凭着什么能知道这事呢？因为我已经老了，我的妻子也上了年纪。} \BibleRef{路 1:19} 天使回答说：\Quote{我是加俾额尔，站在天主面前的，奉命来向你说话，报告你这个喜讯。\BibleRef{路 1:20} 看，你必成为哑巴，不能说话，直到这些事成就的那一天，因为你没有相信我的话；我的话到了时候必然应验。} \BibleRef{路 1:21} 百姓等候匝加利亚，都奇怪他滞留在圣殿内。\BibleRef{路 1:22} 及至他出来，竟不能对他们说话。他们就知道他在圣殿中见了异象；他向他们打手势，竟成了哑巴。\BibleRef{路 1:23} 他供职的日子满了，就回家去了。
latex.p0004: 25 \BibleRef{路 1:24} 这些日子以后，他的妻子依撒伯尔怀了孕；她隐藏了五个月，说：\BibleRef{路 1:25} \Quote{主在眷顾我的日子，这样待了我，除去了我在人前的羞辱。}
latex.p0005: 27 \BibleRef{路 1:26} 到了第六个月，天使加俾额尔奉天主差遣，往加里肋亚一座名叫纳匝肋的城去，\BibleRef{路 1:27} 到一位童贞女那里，她已许配给达味家族的一个名叫若瑟的男子，童贞女的名字叫玛利亚。\BibleRef{路 1:28} 天使进去向她问安说：\Quote{愿你平安！充满恩宠者，主与你同在！你在妇女中受赞颂。} \BibleRef{路 1:29} 她因这话惊惶不安，思虑这样的请安有什么意思。\BibleRef{路 1:30} 天使对她说：\Quote{玛利亚，不要害怕，因为你在天主前获得了宠幸。\BibleRef{路 1:31} 看，你将怀孕生子，并要给他起名叫耶稣。\BibleRef{路 1:32} 他将是伟大的，并被称为至高者的儿子，上主天主要把他祖先达味的御座赐给他。\BibleRef{路 1:33} 他要为王统治雅各伯家，直到永远；他的王权没有终结。} \BibleRef{路 1:34} 玛利亚对天使说：\Quote{这事怎能成就？因为我不认识男人。} \BibleRef{路 1:35} 天使回答她说：\Quote{圣神要临于你，至高者的能力要庇荫你，因此，那要诞生的圣者，将称为天主的儿子。\BibleRef{路 1:36} 且看，你的亲戚依撒伯尔，她虽在老年，却怀了男胎，本月已六个月了，她原是素称不生育的。\BibleRef{路 1:37} 因为在天主前没有不能的事。} \BibleRef{路 1:38} 玛利亚说：\Quote{看，上主的婢女，愿照你的话成就于我吧。} 天使就离开她去了。
latex.p0006: 40 \BibleRef{路 1:39} 玛利亚就在那几日起身，急忙往山区去，来到犹大的一座城，\BibleRef{路 1:40} 进了匝加利亚的家，问依撒伯尔安。\BibleRef{路 1:41} 依撒伯尔一听到玛利亚请安，胎儿就在她腹中欢跃。\BibleRef{路 1:42} 依撒伯尔充满了圣神，大声呼喊说：\Quote{你在妇女中受赞颂，你胎中的胎儿也是受赞颂的！\BibleRef{路 1:43} 我主的母亲到我这里来，这事哪里来的呢？\BibleRef{路 1:44} 看，你请安的声音一入我耳，胎儿就在我腹中欢喜踊跃。\BibleRef{路 1:45} 那信了由上主传于她的话必要完成的，是有福的。} \BibleRef{路 1:46} 玛利亚说：
latex.p0007:
我的灵魂颂扬上主，
ewline{}48 \BibleRef{路 1:47} 我的心灵欢跃于天主，我的救主，
ewline{}49 \BibleRef{路 1:48} 因为他垂顾了他婢女的卑微：
ewline{}看，从今以后，
ewline{}万代都要称我有福。
ewline{}50 \BibleRef{路 1:49} 全能者为我行了大事，
ewline{}他的名字是圣的。
ewline{}51 \BibleRef{路 1:50} 他的仁慈世世代代归于敬畏他的人。
ewline{}52 \BibleRef{路 1:51} 他挥动臂膀施展大能，
ewline{}驱散那些心高气傲的人。
ewline{}53 \BibleRef{路 1:52} 他从高位上推下权贵，
ewline{}却举扬了卑微者。
ewline{}54 \BibleRef{路 1:53} 使饥饿者饱享美物，
ewline{}却使富者空手而去。
ewline{}55 \BibleRef{路 1:54} 他扶助了他的仆人以色列，
ewline{}纪念他的仁慈，
ewline{}56 \BibleRef{路 1:55} 正如他对我们祖先所说的话，
ewline{}对亚伯拉罕和他的后裔，直到永远。
latex.p0008: 57 \BibleRef{路 1:56} 玛利亚同依撒伯尔住了约三个月，就回家去了。
latex.p0009: 58, 59 \BibleRef{路 1:57} 依撒伯尔的产期到了，她生了一个儿子。\BibleRef{路 1:58} 她的邻居和亲戚听说上主大大施恩与她，59 就和她一同欢乐。\BibleRef{路 1:59} 到了第八天，他们来给孩子行割礼，并要叫他匝加利亚，\Emph{照他父亲的名字}称呼他。61 \BibleRef{路 1:60} 但他母亲回答说：\Quote{不，要叫他若翰。}62 \BibleRef{路 1:61} 他们便说：\Quote{你亲族中没有人叫这名字的。}63, 64 \BibleRef{路 1:62} 他们就向他父亲打手势，\Emph{问他}愿意叫他什么名字。\BibleRef{路 1:63} 他要了一块写字板，写道：\Quote{他的名字是若翰。}众人就惊讶。65 \BibleRef{路 1:64} 他的口和舌头立刻开了，就说话并赞美天主。\BibleRef{路 1:65} 所有邻居都害怕；这事传遍了犹大整个山区。67 \BibleRef{路 1:66} 凡听见的人都心里思想，说：\Quote{这孩子将会成为什么人物呢？}因为上主的手与他同在。
latex.p0010: 68 \BibleRef{路 1:67} 他的父亲匝加利亚充满了圣神，预言说：
latex.p0011:
69 \BibleRef{路 1:68} 上主，以色列的天主，应受赞美，
ewline{}因他眷顾了他的子民，为他们施行了救恩；
ewline{}70 \BibleRef{路 1:69} 并为我们兴起了救恩的角，
ewline{}在他仆人达味的家中，
ewline{}71 \BibleRef{路 1:70} 正如他借历代圣先知的口所说的，
ewline{}72 \BibleRef{路 1:71} 拯救我们脱离敌人，
ewline{}和一切恨我们的人手中。
ewline{}73 \BibleRef{路 1:72} 他向我们的祖先施行仁慈，
ewline{}纪念他的神圣盟约，
ewline{}74 \BibleRef{路 1:73} 就是他向我们的祖先亚伯拉罕所起的誓，
ewline{}75 \BibleRef{路 1:74} 要把我们从敌人手中救出，
ewline{}使我们无所恐惧，在他面前侍奉，
ewline{}76 \BibleRef{路 1:75} 以圣洁和正义度日。
ewline{}77 \BibleRef{路 1:76} 至于你，孩子，你要称为至高者的先知，
ewline{}你要走在主的前面，预备他的道路，
ewline{}78 \BibleRef{路 1:77} 使他的百姓认识救恩，
ewline{}以得赦免他们的罪过，
ewline{}79 \BibleRef{路 1:78} 因我们天主的慈爱和怜悯，
ewline{}他眷顾我们，使旭日从高天降临，
ewline{}80 \BibleRef{路 1:79} 照亮坐在黑暗中、死影下的人，
ewline{}引导我们的脚步走上平安的道路。
latex.p0012: 81 那孩子渐渐长大，心灵强健，住在旷野，直到他显现在以色列人面前的日子。
